response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrated experience in C++ at scale and has no evidence of leading cloud compute infrastructure projects, which are core requirements; while they show broad full-stack and open-source experience, their work centers on TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies, not the C++-centric, distributed systems, or cloud compute leadership the role demands.
strengths: Strong open-source contributions and community engagement
Extensive experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven mentorship and workshop leadership in software practices
concerns: No visible C++ experience beyond academic or minor use; fails minimum 8-year requirement
Lacks documented leadership in cloud compute, distributed systems, or infrastructure design
No evidence of managing large-scale internal platform projects or technical strategy ownership
